name: Collector D
source:
By the year 2000 an incurable disease has spread and men and women have become unable to have normal sex without vibrators. Hero is a designer of such vibrators. He comes to a new residential area as a sales agent.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-july-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
到2000年，一種無法治癒的疾病蔓延開來，男人和女人離開按摩棒就無法正常性交。主角是一名按摩棒設計師，以推銷員身分來到新住宅區。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-july-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
